purpose: Predeclared independent subtalker-temperature candidate; compare with all retained original main-0.7/subtalker-0.7 baseline outputs; no production promotion

texts.text: 持续验证语音服务的稳定性和恢复能力。
请在十一月六日下午三点，把编号一二三四的文件发送给李明。
Verify that the speech service remains stable and recovers after an interruption.
On November sixth at three in the afternoon, send file one two three four to Alice.

pairing: Reuse each existing baseline for the same text/voice/seed; generate each independent subtalker-0.9 candidate once
baseline_parity_required: Both seed-196 baseline outputs in completed preliminary six-case diagnostic matched original production SDK token/PCM; both candidate repetitions and real ASR content passed
stop_rule: Complete all predeclared cases regardless of EOS outcome; stop only on parity failure, process error or resource/time bounds
outputs: Full per-case token and PCM hashes, EOS, duration, wall time; original PCM remains private
quality_followup: After termination transcribe all 144 candidate outputs with unchanged final-App ASR; compare each to the retained 144 baseline outputs and ASR results
promotion_requirements: No candidate is promoted from this diagnostic alone. Any production change must retain interface/cancellation/update checks, pass the original strict two-hour target gate and fixed corpus regression, and obtain human listening evidence
